verdict.rationale: mise has a dedicated first-party docs page (mise.jdx.dev/mcp.html) for an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant inspect a project's tools, tasks, environment and configuration, and run mise tasks. That covers the core of connecting an agent through an official MCP server, but the evidence is a single descriptive line. Missing for 10: documented setup and connection steps for agent clients, the transport and stability/experimental status, the full list of exposed tools and permission controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
